doi:10.0000/synth.d.001.title: Incremental import reconciliation for scholarly knowledge bases
doi:10.0000/synth.d.001.abstract: We formalize incremental import as a state reconciliation problem and show that fingerprint-based classification prevents silent re-imports in scholarly knowledge bases.

doi:10.0000/synth.d.002.title: Provenance-aware deduplication in systematic literature pipelines
doi:10.0000/synth.d.002.abstract: A survey of deduplication strategies that preserve provenance chains when systematic review pipelines merge records from heterogeneous sources.

doi:10.0000/synth.d.003.title: Idempotent upsert semantics for offline corpus snapshots
doi:10.0000/synth.d.003.abstract: We define upsert semantics under which re-applying the same offline corpus snapshot leaves the import state byte-identical, and prove a convergence lemma.
